t: This is Blackwall Yard, on the Thames at Blackwall. It's a former shipyard, and shipbuilding has gone on in this area since the Middle Ages. The yard built ships and later repaired them for over 350 years, before closing in 1987. Robert Fotherby, an early seventeenth-century English explorer and whaler, died here in 1646. He worked for the Muscovy Company from 1613 to 1615, and then for the East India Company until his death.
